title: Donut chart
description: Two to six slices of a thick ring are drawn one after another from 12 o'clock (anime.js svg.createDrawable, stroke-dasharray), the total in the middle counts with the sweep, and each legend line (colour, label, value) comes in as its slice starts. The ring takes most of the slide height; on a phone it sits above the legend.

props.parts: required, 2-6 of {label, value, color}: real numbers; color 1-6 picks gold, light gold, blue, clay, ivory or dark gold (default: in that order)
props.title: heading, 3-7 words
props.total: number in the middle (default: the sum of the values)
